title: The Effect of Intangible Asset Classification on Professional Financial Statement Users’ Assessments

scopes.description: Reproduce the as-supplied reported Online Appendix A and B results from the author workflow; this release supplies only the results appendix.

requirements.description: The participant-level observations or author-prepared analysis input(s) needed to reproduce the reported Online Appendix A and B results; exact files, fields, condition coding, and format are not specified in this release.

issues.description: The only inventoried package item is a results appendix PDF; it contains reported results and explanatory prose but no executable program or manual procedure. No supplied entry point is available to run.

The appendix gives outcome tables and a short description of participant measures but no data files, executable/manual analysis workflow, field or condition-coding contract, input format, or software specification. The exact required analysis inputs and producer sequence therefore remain unknown.

evidence.description: The appendix's reported experimental outcome is described as participant responses on a riskiness measure.
evidence.quote:
Online Appendix A presents the results for dependent variable Category Riskiness. Category Riskiness is measured using participants'
responses to the question, "How risky are the following assets for MSM Inc.?" where "Intangibles" and "Investments" are listed as
two of the items they assess. Participants respond on a 101-point scale with endpoints Not at All Risky (0) and Very Risky (100).

evidence.description: The frozen work-item inventory lists one material package file, the online-appendix PDF; no data or executable source is inventoried.
The bounded static audit records one document file, no entry points or dependency edges, and coverage status no_supported_code; this is discovery corroboration only.

actions.description: Obtain the author-supplied workflow and analysis inputs needed to reproduce Online Appendix A and B. The supplied release is results-only, so the audit does not infer a separate raw-source reconstruction or software stack.
steps: Request the executable programs or complete manual procedure that produced Online Appendix A and B, including their intended order and intermediate files.

Request the author-prepared analysis input files or exact input specifications, plus a data dictionary stating the observation unit, required variables, condition coding, file formats, and how the two dependent-variable results are constructed.
Ask the authors to identify required software and version and any omitted preparation, transformation, or table-production steps.
validation: After receiving the materials, trace each required input and producer through both appendix tables and compare the documented field, condition, observation-unit, type, and construction contracts before assessing resource or software availability.

review_notes: This assessment covers the frozen PDF-only release. The supplied appendix does not state a conflicting paper title or DOI; the frozen header is retained.

The only package item is the online appendix with reported results. No analysis dataset, executable code, manual procedure, named commercial or public source product, or required software is specified.
